\tikzset{

  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},

\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},

\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small, x={(1cm,0cm)}, y={(0.45cm,0.32cm)}, z={(0cm,1cm)}]
  % the scattering plane (x-y plane of this drawing)
  \fill[figB!8] (-0.8,-1.6,0) -- (4.4,-1.6,0) -- (4.4,3.2,0) -- (-0.8,3.2,0) -- cycle;
  \draw[figB!40, line width=0.4pt] (-0.8,-1.6,0) -- (4.4,-1.6,0) -- (4.4,3.2,0) -- (-0.8,3.2,0) -- cycle;
  \node[font=\scriptsize, figB!70!black] at (0.9,-1.2,0) {scattering plane};
  \draw[->, >=Stealth, line width=1.0pt, figB] (0,0,0) -- (3.4,0,0) node[right] {$\mathbf p$};
  \draw[->, >=Stealth, line width=1.0pt, figR] (0,0,0) -- (1.6,3.0,0) node[above right=-2pt] {$\mathbf p'$};
  \draw[line width=0.5pt] (0.9,0,0) arc[start angle=0, end angle=61.9, x radius=0.9, y radius=0.9];
  \node at (1.25,0.55,0) {$\theta$};
  % p' x p points along -z of this drawing for p along x, p' towards +y
  \draw[->, >=Stealth, line width=1.0pt, figO] (0,0,0) -- (0,0,-1.5) node[below] {$\mathbf B = \dfrac{\mathbf p'\times\mathbf p}{E + m}$};
  \draw[black!50, densely dashed] (0,0,0) -- (0,0,1.3);
  \node[font=\scriptsize, black!60] at (0.55,0,1.25) {normal};
  \node[font=\scriptsize, align=left, anchor=west] at (5.6,0,-0.9) {$|\mathbf B| = (E - m)\sin\theta$\\[2pt] spins along the normal: diagonal, $A \pm i|\mathbf B|$\\[2pt] another axis: off-diagonal entries $|\mathbf B_\perp|$};
\end{tikzpicture}
